name: ai_instruction
description: Instructions for the AI chat that apply to every item under the folder this resource lives in, like an AGENTS.md: an ai_instruction at f/billing/AGENTS is given to the assistant whenever it works on something under f/billing/. The file body is the instructions it follows.

name: ai_skill
description: A reusable instruction set for the AI chat, in the SKILL.md format. The resource description is what the assistant sees when deciding whether the skill applies; the file body is the instructions it follows.

name: airtable
description: Airtable API key or personal access token, sent as a bearer token to the Airtable REST API.

name: asana
description: Credentials for the Asana work management API using a personal access token.

name: aws
description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) credentials: access key ID, secret access key and default region.

name: azure_blob
description: Connection settings for a Microsoft Azure Blob Storage container: account name, container name, access key and endpoint.

name: clickup
description: Credentials for the ClickUp API v2 using a personal API token.

token.description: API token retrieved from the dashboard.

name: discord_webhook
description:
Discord incoming webhook URL for posting messages to a Discord channel.

See: <https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/228383668-Intro-to-Webhooks>

name: gcal
description: Google OAuth token authorizing the Google Calendar API.

token.description: The OAuth token, refreshed if necessary

name: gcp_service_account
description: Google Cloud service account key (JSON) used to authenticate to Google Cloud APIs.

name: github
description: GitHub token (OAuth or personal access token) authorizing the GitHub REST API: repositories, issues and pull requests.

name: gitlab
description: Credentials for the GitLab API v4 using a personal access token, with the base URL of the GitLab instance (self-hosted or gitlab.com).

name: gmail
description: Google OAuth token authorizing the Gmail API to send email as the connected Google account.

name: gsheets
description: Google OAuth token authorizing the Google Sheets API for reading and writing spreadsheets.

token.description: The OAuth token, refreshed if necessary

name: hubspot
description: Credentials for the HubSpot CRM API using a private app access token.

token.description: Access token of a private app

name: jira
description: Credentials for the Jira Cloud REST API using basic authentication with an Atlassian site domain.

name: linear
description: Credentials for the Linear issue tracking API using a personal API key.

apiKey.description: A personal API key (lin_api_…) created under Settings → Security & access → Personal API keys (https://linear.app/settings/account/security).

name: mailchimp
description: API key and account data center prefix (e.g. us12) for the Mailchimp Marketing API.

server.description: The data center for your Mailchimp account. (For example: us12)

name: mongodb
description: Connection settings for a MongoDB database: server host/port list, database name, TLS and SCRAM credentials.

name: mysql
description: Connection settings for a MySQL database, with optional SSL and a root CA certificate.

name: notion
description: Notion API token: filled by Windmill's Notion OAuth connect, or an internal connection's API token / personal access token pasted in.

token.description: Filled automatically when you connect with OAuth. To paste one instead: the API token of an internal connection (ntn_…) or a personal access token, both created in the Notion developer portal at https://www.notion.so/developers. A connection token only reaches the pages granted to it under Content access.

name: openai
description: OpenAI secret API key, with optional organization ID and base URL override, for the OpenAI API.

base_url.description: Optional. Only needed to overwrite the default base URL.

organization_id.description: Only needs to be set for users who belong to multiple organizations and they want to use an organization other than the default one

name: postgresql
description: Connection settings for a PostgreSQL database: host, port, database name, user, password and SSL/IAM auth options.

region.description: AWS region for IAM auth (e.g. us-east-1). Falls back to AWS_REGION env var if not set.

options.description: Startup options sent to the server (the libpq options parameter), such as endpoint=<endpoint-id> for a Neon pooled or private connection, or -c search_path=myschema

sslmode.description: Most cloud databases (Heroku, AWS, Supabase, etc.) require SSL. Self-hosted databases typically don't.

use_iam_auth.description: Use IAM authentication (AWS RDS/Aurora). When enabled, the password field is ignored and a short-lived IAM token is generated instead.

accept_invalid_certs.description: Accept any certificate presented by the server, which disables TLS certificate verification and is not recommended. Only applies to verify-ca/verify-full.

root_certificate_pem.description: The root certificate in pe format

name: s3
description: Connection settings for an Amazon S3 (AWS) bucket: endpoint, region, bucket name and access keys.

port.description: Deprecated: pass in a complete URL to `endPoint` instead, including a port number if needed

region.description: AWS region (e.g. us-east-1). Used to auto-generate the S3 endpoint URL when endPoint is not specified

useSSL.description: Deprecated: pass in a complete URL to `endPoint` instead, including 'https://' or 'http://'

endPoint.description: The full URL of the S3 endpoint (e.g. https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com)

name: salesforce
description: Salesforce OAuth Authorization Code credential. The token is populated by Windmill's OAuth flow; instance_url pins every REST call to the org's data host, api_version selects the REST API version.

token.description: OAuth access token. Populated by Windmill's OAuth flow.

api_version.description: Salesforce REST API version path segment, e.g. v60.0. Optional — scripts default to v60.0 when left blank.

instance_url.description: Org data host returned in the OAuth token response, e.g. https://acme.my.salesforce.com (production) or https://acme--sandbox.sandbox.my.salesforce.com (sandbox). Every REST call is made against this host, not login.salesforce.com.

name: sendgrid
description: Twilio SendGrid API key for the SendGrid v3 API: transactional email, contacts, marketing lists and bounces.

name: shopify
description: Credentials for the Shopify Admin API using a store name and access token.

name: slack
description: Slack bot or user OAuth token authorizing the Slack Web API (messages, channels, users and files).

name: smtp
description: Connection settings for an SMTP mail server used to send email.

port.description: port number on which to connect

name: stripe
description: Stripe secret API key for the Stripe payments API.

name: supabase
description:
Supabase project URL and API key for the Supabase REST, auth and storage APIs.

Retrieve both values in "Project Settings -> API".

key.description: The unique Supabase Key which is supplied when you create a new project in your project dashboard.

url.description: The unique Supabase URL which is supplied when you create a new project in your project dashboard.

name: twilio
description: Credentials for the Twilio messaging and voice API using an Account SID and auth token.

name: zendesk
description: Zendesk API credentials: account subdomain plus email and password or API token, used with HTTP Basic auth.

username.description: email or "{email}/token" if using an api token
